task: Stage the barsoap and toothbrush together in the bathroomcabinet, then leave the barsoap stored there and deliver the toothbrush to the bed, with the bathroomcabinet closed.
generated_programs:
# Go to the bathroom to locate the items and cabinet
find('bathroom')
walk('bathroom')
# Locate and retrieve the barsoap
find('barsoap')
grab('barsoap')
# Locate and retrieve the toothbrush
find('toothbrush')
grab('toothbrush')
# Open the bathroom cabinet and stage both items together inside
find('bathroomcabinet')
open('bathroomcabinet')
putin('barsoap','bathroomcabinet')
putin('toothbrush','bathroomcabinet')

grab('toothbrush')
# Close the bathroom cabinet with the barsoap remaining inside
close('bathroomcabinet')
# Deliver the toothbrush to the bed
find('bed')
walk('bed')
putback('toothbrush','bed')
